title: Free Browser AI Roguelike Project Almost Done
author: PaulBellow
selftext:
I started this back in 2023 or so then gave up for a while. About a month ago, I started from scratch and haven't stopped until I had this demo...

  
The LLM stuff isn't in the game yet, but the previous version had it. Costs stopped me mostly, but with better local models now, I'm wondering if it'll work better/cheaper.

The game is the [Tower of Gates roguelike](https://www.litrpgadventures.com/free-roguelike/) and you can play now. (A few people have beat all 12 levels!)

https://i.redd.it/s9ieevrwc7gg1.gif

https://i.redd.it/wbvbz49yc7gg1.gif

https://i.redd.it/cy7teb7zc7gg1.gif

https://i.redd.it/8lx1is5ed7gg1.gif

Not much attention on it so far, but it's been fun building it out. I've used AI for art, brainstorming, and coding inside ChatGPT Pro. (Stack is HTML5 (canvas 2d) and vanilla javascript. 

This is the old version with LLM built into the game itself (talk to your magic sword about how you've been doing, talk to the shopkeeper, etc...)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1rRS2XlrVs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1rRS2XlrVs)

I'm a writer more than a coder, but with the help of AI, I actually put together something I've been dreaming about since I wrote a [roguelike novel](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B084JNNZ6V) several years ago.

Would love to hear any thoughts or questions you might have. Thanks for listening!

comments.author: PaulBellow
comments.body: Mods were okay with me posting years okay. Hope it's still okay. Sorry if not!

comments.author: PaulBellow
comments.body: I started over on 12/26, so this is about four weeks of work (double shifts + AI boost) equals a lot of productivity. Having done it once kinda clunky, it was somehow easier the second time.
